agencyName: Wyoming State Fire Marshal's Office, Department of Fire Prevention and Electrical Safety
authorityRationale: The department's own dedicated licensing page, explicitly naming a separate reciprocal-state list for Journeyman (17 states) and Master (3 states) electricians, plus exact exam-score thresholds, minimum license duration, one-time-reciprocity restriction, grandfathering exclusion, and failed-exam waiting period. Corroborated for the statutory framework by W.S. 35-9-126(d) (read via law.justia.com/codes.findlaw.com mirrors) and for exam-score/duration/good-standing detail by Wyo. Code R. Agency 041, Subagency 0001, Ch. 5 SS5-5 (read via law.cornell.edu mirror, effective 7/19/2023).
reliabilityRationale: Official department page, actively maintained (references an April 2025 fee-processing change and a July 2026 NEC-edition change), used as the single canonical source for both Wyoming electrician tiers. One point — whether the Wyoming exam itself is waived for reciprocal applicants — could not be independently confirmed against a clean verbatim read of the administrative rule text and is recorded as needs_review rather than silently resolved in either direction.
